name: rentadriver-delivery
description: Check delivery coverage, request a price, book package deliveries and track their progress with RentADriver. Delivery coverage currently includes service areas in the United Kingdom, United States and Moldova; check coverage for each pickup and drop-off. Booking requires a connected RentADriver account and sufficient prepaid wallet balance. Prices and driver availability come from the service; coverage does not guarantee an available driver or pickup time.

interface.longDescription: Check delivery coverage and get a price for a package delivery without an account, then sign in to book, fund and track deliveries with RentADriver. Delivery coverage currently includes service areas in the United Kingdom, United States and Moldova; check coverage for each pickup and drop-off. Booking requires a connected RentADriver account and sufficient prepaid wallet balance. Prices and driver availability come from the service; coverage does not guarantee an available driver or pickup time.
defaultPrompt: Quote a small parcel from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station. Do not book it.
Show my active deliveries and their latest tracking status.

positive.prompt: Without connecting an account, which cities does RentADriver cover, and is London Waterloo station covered?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs anonymously (no sign-in prompt). Returns current service areas and coverage for London Waterloo, and says coverage does not guarantee a driver or pickup time.

positive.prompt: Quote a small parcel from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station. Do not book it.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs anonymously. Returns the current price, currency and quote identifier without booking, and does not invent driver availability or promise a pickup time.

positive.description: Account and wallet read (sign-in when needed)
positive.prompt: Show my RentADriver account status and country wallet balances.
positive.expected_behavior: If not yet connected, ChatGPT shows the sign-in prompt for this tool only. After connecting the sandbox account, returns the account status and its balance in each workspace currency, with no deposit or transfer.

positive.prompt: List my sandbox deliveries, then show the status, tracking and proof for RD-7DSIXLA. If unavailable, use a sandbox delivery from the returned list.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sandbox delivery list and the actual status, tracking and simulated photo proof for the chosen delivery.

positive.prompt: Preview a small parcel delivery from London Waterloo station to London Bridge station without placing an order.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns dry_run=true with fund=false. No booking is created and no funds are reserved.

negative.description: Passenger transport is unsupported; no delivery tools should run
negative.prompt: Book a passenger taxi from my hotel to the airport.
Email a PDF to my colleague.

negative.description: General writing request with no delivery action
negative.prompt: Write a birthday card message for my sister.

review.commerce_description: No products or subscriptions are sold in chat. Deliveries are paid from the customer's own prepaid RentADriver wallet, topped up on the RentADriver website.

publication.release_notes: Icon update: the app icon is now the RentADriver mark on a white rounded tile with transparent corners (1.1.0 showed white square corners around the tile). No tool, authentication or listing changes.
